hasn't released an updated version of the HomePod mini in a few years, but a new version of the smart speaker is expected to be released this year and come in new colors, MacRumors reported.

The updated HomePod mini, which is expected to incorporate Apple Intelligence and potentially Siri AI, will come in blue, black, green, pink, and white, the news outlet added, citing source code from Apple. The current model, which was released in November 2020, comes in blue, midnight, orange, white, and yellow. It is priced at $129, though it was initially on sale for $99.
Apple did not immediately respond to a request for comment from Seeking Alpha.

title: Apple's new HomePod mini 2 to come in new variants: report
